answer: The economy spends reputation the way a market spends money: sparingly and against verified performance, so Sybil inflation is filtered out before it can compound into a decisive advantage. The mechanism therefore aligns self-interest with network health: an attacker gains most by behaving honestly, because that is the only move that scales.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a delta as the anchor of the cost. A wharf stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a spiral...
